description: PII red-team set (PII plan): questions that push names and identifiers through the agent. Names are from the test orgs' seed data (orgs 24-33); identifiers are synthetic. 'pii' lists values the user types that must never reach the model; 'gap' marks a known limitation whose leak is expected and reported apart (none since name recognition on questions, privacy/ner.py). Run with scripts/eval/pii_redteam.py.
